title: Battlecross — Cinematic Trailer | Cute Action RPG, Free in Your Browser
description: Ride out of Sunford, get gored into a wall by a goblin king's war boar, roll out from under a dragon's fire and bring down the Arch-Demon in a cute action RPG.
▶ Coming soon, free in your browser: no download, no install.
You start as a militia recruit with a rusty sword and grow into whatever hero you want: any hero can learn from any trainer.
• Mix skills from 8 classes: a knight's shield with a pyromancer's fire, royal guards, stopped time, a beam from the sky
• Boss fights with a plan of their own: a war boar that charges, a dragon that takes to the sky, a demon who dives from above
• Roll out of danger: every hero dodges, and the red marks on the ground show where a big attack will land
• 12 zones in 6 tiers, from sunny plains to the Dread Fortress, plus a colosseum ladder
• 44 named weapons, armours and rings: every drop is a find
• 6 choices that change the towns, the trainers, who hunts you and how the story ends
